title: chat-server: public helper to store server-originated Messages
description: Extensions (MIMI fanout per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §application/mimi-fanout; also federation inbound delivery) must store Messages the server creates: server-reserved bodyType, server-chosen senderId/senderMsgId/sentAt. Today the only path is ChatBackend::create_object::<Message> directly (backend.rs:504), which skips (1) dedup by senderMsgId within the Chat (mimi draft: 'MUST NOT store a FanoutMessage whose senderMsgId it has already stored in the Chat'), and (2) ReadPosition creation on a Chat's first message (ensure_read_positions, message.rs:574, private). Add one public fn (e.g. store_server_message(backend, caller, account_id, Message) -> Result<StoredOutcome>) that does both and returns Stored(id) or Duplicate(existing id). Byte-identical-body dedup and hub ChatContact policy stay in the extension. ChatContact get-or-create needs no work: create_object::<ChatContact> returns alreadyExists with existing_id on an identity clash (backend.rs:478-485).
acceptance_criteria: Public helper; tests: stores a reserved-bodyType Message, second call with same senderMsgId in same Chat returns Duplicate and writes nothing, same senderMsgId in another Chat stores, first message creates ReadPositions like Message/set does.
notes: Folded into JMAP-5mz6 (Chat extension seams in chat-server/chat-types) by the 2026-10-19 spec gap audit.
